title: US Take-Home Pay & Local Income Tax Rates 2026
description:
Open CSV data behind the free calculators at dolidob.com. Every official figure is checked against a government source.

  • take-home-pay-by-state-2026.csv: federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, state income tax, state employee contributions and take-home pay for 50 states and DC, salaries $30,000 to $250,000 (single filer, paid every two weeks, no 401(k)).
  • take-home-pay-by-state-2026-married-joint.csv: the same figures for married filing jointly, one spouse earning the salary and the other with no wages.
  • us-local-income-tax-rates.csv: 789 city and county wage taxes in MI, IN, MD, NY, PA and OH, with the official source for each row.
  • ohio-municipal-income-tax-rates.csv: every Ohio municipality with an income tax (Ohio Department of Taxation).
  • federal-income-tax-brackets.csv: 2026 and 2027 federal brackets and standard deductions (IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and 2026-35).

Column definitions are in datapackage.json. Estimates for education, not tax advice.
